text: Three transposition stages in a row, drawn from 211 single stages (keyed column shuffles, rotations, grids), sampled 200,000 times, each followed by the table.
The best key run on the copper scores above every shuffled copper, but the shuffles were run with far fewer samples than the copper, so the comparison is unfair.
Recorded as chance, and a rule added to the loop: every diagnostic needs at least ten shuffled controls run at full size, with the same number of trials as the copper.
